tools.name: ecca_synthesize
tools.description: Compare answers from configured engines and inspect disagreement, with lexical similarity and final-answer agreement when measurable.

tools.name: ecca_pre_mortem
tools.description: Executes an adversarial pre-mortem identifying failure modes and early warning indicators using empirical argument verification.

tools.name: ecca_decision_tournament
tools.description: Evaluates multi-option decision matrix using minimax regret and Pareto ranking over candidate pathways.

tools.name: ecca_bts_divergence
tools.description: Measures lexical and semantic divergence across candidate assertions to penalize sycophancy.

tools.name: ecca_refine
tools.description: Use one keyed tier-quota slot to sharpen rough student questions without adding facts; return detected niches and refinement chips. A closed engine ceiling falls back locally.

tools.name: ecca_research
tools.description: Use one keyed tier-quota slot and dispatch-ceiling reservation to fetch and grade studies from scholarly indexes; return fetched evidence and explicit gaps.

tools.name: ecca_verify
tools.description: Independently answer a question and compare the candidate against deterministic panel agreement. Show named dissent; spends one solve.

tools.name: ecca_psychology
tools.description: Psychology research: refine the question, fetch studies, and show named claims before the verdict. Applies evidence and claims checks; spends one solve.

tools.name: ecca_learning
tools.description: Learning and study skills: refine the question, fetch studies, and show named claims before the verdict. Applies evidence and claims checks; spends one solve.

tools.name: ecca_nutrition
tools.description: Nutrition and supplements: refine the question, fetch studies, and show named claims before the verdict. Applies evidence and claims checks; spends one solve.

tools.name: ecca_money
tools.description: Money and business: refine the question, fetch studies, and show named claims before the verdict. Applies evidence and claims checks; spends one solve.

tools.name: ecca_claim_protocol_validate
tools.description: Check one ecca.claim-protocol 1.0 document for shape: versioned, engine slots only (no vendor names), split causes from the published taxonomy, question text only with consent, seal present. Returns ok with the error list; validates shape, never the record behind it.
